Range 30 feet

Targets 1 willing ally

Duration 1 minute

Lend your Ward's sense to an ally briefly, letting them perceive a Named Anchor as clearly as you do.

The ally perceives every Anchor you have Named exactly as you perceive it: it knows which creatures are Named, what their Anchors are, and it can see a Named creature's true form and true location through disguise, invisibility, or possession, with no check. It cannot Name an Anchor itself, and it cannot Break one.
